name: Akuma
subtitle: Raging Demon
description: This hero story is yet to be revealed.
lore: The akuma are demonic entities, beings of confusion, misfortune, and death. In the mortal world, they appear as warriors of steel and flame. While they enjoy the ill luck their mere presence brings to others, they particularly revel in violence. They take the most joy from cutting down skilled warriors, but they readily settle for massacring the helpless.
